title: Vitamin A, Its Receptors and Asthma
brief_summary: We wish to understand the association of Vitamin A serum levels and Vitamin A receptor number and responsiveness in asthmatics. We believe that Vitamin A receptors may be less prevalent in asthmatics and their responsiveness decreased.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with previously diagnosed asthma on inhaled corticosteroids, systemic steroids and/or long acting beta agonist (for a period of 6 mo to 5 years)
* Age 18-64
* Male or female

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children under age 18
* Adults 65 or older
* Patients with COPD
